services.name: The Local Free Tasting
services.desc: The ONE Arts after school art program engages the whole child with an emphasis on visual arts. We acknowledge the need for play in order for creative intelligence to flourish. As Maria Montessori said, “Play is the work of the child.” We offer outdoor free play and always circle back to visual arts. We cover weaving, gelli printing, gesture drawing, mask-making and clay among other activities. After School Art Sessions for the 2026-2027 school year are now open for registration. blurb: Camp Meade is the new Middlesex, VT village hub. Uniting visitors and the local community with our showcase of quirky Vermont taste and creativity. Home to Red Hen Bakery and Café, The Local, The Planetary Arts Institute, The Why Art House, and The Green. Camp Meade.
